item.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Bypasses Gym Booking Limit, Cancels Other Users' Reservations in Tests
item.summary: Aikido Security has published research that recreates the Australian gym-booking incident in a synthetic environment, finding that Claude Opus 4.6, running on the OpenClaw agent harness, exploited a client-side-only booking restriction in 9 of 10 runs.
